messages:
sam: Deploybot flagged canary p95 +22% starting 05:30 UTC for rw-infer/transformer-3 v3.6.1-canary. No error increase. Asking for rollback approach. :wave:
nina: scope? canary is 7% traffic (ap-south + us-west). Any recent infra flags?
sam: new quantization codec + tvm kernel tweak included in this build. Logs show tail latency on token window 10-30.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: AUTO-ROLLBACK status: suppressed. Criteria: error_rate<2% & latency_delta>+15% -> require human decision. Suggested mitigations: [1] flag-toggle kernel_codec_v2, [2] version-pin to v3.6.0, [3] increase canary telemetry window.
infra: quick metric pull: kv_cache_hitrate dropped from 0.91 -> 0.82. avg_batch_size steady. Looks like cache alignment issue.
product-eng: Given no errors, prefer narrow rollback: toggle codec flag first. Lower customer impact and faster validation.
nina: agree. If flag toggle doesn't correct p95 within 8min, escalate to version pin. Ops — can you run staged toggle?
sam: ops not in thread, I'll run the CLI. Using staged 20% -> 50% -> 100% so we can abort early.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: FLAG_TOGGLE command: rb flag toggle --model rw-infer/transformer-3 --flag kernel_codec_v2 --stages 20,50,100 --wait 480. Estimated per-stage apply ~45s.
sam: starting stage 20 now. change-id change-1766599999-01.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: FLAG stage applied: 20%. kernel_codec_v2=false on 20% canary.
infra: quick smoke 10 requests -> p95 down ~9%. good signal.
sam: moving to 50%.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: FLAG stage applied: 50%.
product-eng: monitoring looks better, kv_cache_hitrate recovering to 0.87.
sam: moving to 100%.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: FLAG stage applied: 100%. All canary traffic now using previous codec/kernel.
in`: typo fix remains.
infrastructure: full smoke (50 calls) -> p95 back within 3% baseline. No errors.
product-eng: great. Draft internal release note: "Mitigated canary latency regression by toggling kernel_codec_v2 flag; follow-up ticket RW-1588 opened for codec/kernel interaction and cache alignment tests."
sam: opening RW-1588 and adding reproducer.
nina: no customer-facing comms needed unless customers report issues. Notify support to watch.
deploy-bot: Deploybot: ROLLBACK action not required. Flag toggle recorded change-1766599999-01.
product-eng: please update runbook with exact CLI commands and add test to CI for kv cache hitrate regression on codec changes.
sam: will do. Closing thread after RW-1588 created and runbook updated. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
